createCampaign.title: Create Campaign
createCampaign.desc: Launch a new usability test for testers.
createCampaign.targetingDesc: Leave blank to accept any tester. Fill these out to filter who can see and claim this job.
createCampaign.scenarioPlaceholder: Brief the tester on the context. E.g. 'Imagine you are a busy mom looking for a quick dinner recipe...'
createCampaign.taskPlaceholderMCQ: e.g. Which plan would you choose for your needs?
createCampaign.taskPlaceholderFree: e.g. Find the pricing page and describe what you see
createCampaign.taskPlaceholderRating: e.g. How easy was it to find the checkout button?
createCampaign.tips1desc: Instead of "Explore the site", use "Find the return policy page."
createCampaign.tips2desc: Let the user find the answer naturally.
createCampaign.tips3desc: Ask testers to speak their thoughts as they complete the task.
createCampaign.timeLimitDesc: Most tasks should take 1-2 minutes. Only use 5 minutes for complex workflows.
